source.author: verg
source.text: Incipe, parve puer, risu cognoscere matrem, matri longa decem tulerunt fastidia menses.
source.text_original: Incipe, parve puer, risu cognoscere matrem, / matri longa decem tulerunt fastidia menses.
source.text_english: Begin, little boy, to know your mother by her smile; your mother has borne ten long months of weariness for you.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: putasne, frustra infans paruulus et qui uix matrem risu et uultus hilaritate cognoscat, qui nec boni aliquid fecit nec mali, daemone corripitur, morbo opprimitur regio et ea sustinet, quae uidemus inpios homines non sustinere et sustinere deo seruientes?
reuse.text_original: 'putasne, frustra infans paruulus et qui uix matrem risu et uultus hilaritate cognoscat, qui nec boni aliquid fecit nec mali, daemone corripitur, morbo opprimitur regio et ea sustinet, quae uidemus inpios homines non sustinere et sustinere deo seruientes?
reuse.text_english: Do you think that it is in vain that a little infant, who can scarcely recognize his mother by a smile and cheerfulness of face, who has done nothing either good or bad, is seized by a demon, crushed by jaundice, and endures what we see impious men do not endure and what those serving God do endure?
